purpose.summary: GLP002 is a General Ledger 'Delete Account' program, part of a larger accounting/ERP system called GLEDGER. It allows an authorised user to delete a G/L account record, with security checks (LS0-GLLEV < 3 triggers 'Not Authorised'), screen-based interaction, and file I/O against multiple ledger files.

verdict.notes: The file is clearly production-quality COBOL from a commercial General Ledger package (GLEDGER) authored by J.W. Lemmon, originally written in 1983 and updated through 2012. The $set directive and CRT/SCREEN SECTION features are characteristic of Micro Focus or GnuCOBOL. Many COPY statements reference external copybooks that are not shown (truncated source). The source uses latin-1 encoding, which accounts for the box-drawing characters. Line sequence numbers appear on many (but not all) lines, consistent with fixed-format COBOL with some free-format mixed in for the compiler directive at the top.
